title: Zero-step run
statement: Let $R$ be a number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of labels, let $P$ be a counter program over them, and let $x$ be a bit string. For every abstract state $s$, running $P$ on $x$ from $s$ for zero steps returns $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A counter program $P$ over these registers and labels
replaced:
For every counter program $P$ over $R$ registers with labels in $\Lambda$, every input bit string
$x$ and every abstract state $s$, running $P$ on $x$ from $s$ for zero steps returns $s$:
$\mathrm{run}_{P,x}(s, 0) = s$.
